lessonsFromGatewayIngest: Gateway is a distinct assurance layer between programme delivery and EPA: GATEWAY_READINESS ≠ Block Primary ≠ Group CEA ≠ EPA.
Apprentice/Assessor paired documents should be first-class LinkedAssessmentInstrument pairs in the Portal.
Gateway Component Assessment codes (GW1AC01…) are stable IDs for PracticalAssessmentTask entities with Pass/Refer criteria.
Knowledge practice papers ≠ live online knowledge banks — model both, link when IDs like ST0499-AP01GW1K appear.
Filename tokens (EPA, EPS, EPA Practice) are unreliable; content classification is mandatory.
Seeded-fault assessor setup lists are valuable structured fields (faultCatalogue[]) for generating consistent practicals.
onboardingImplication: Future multi-standard onboarding checklist should explicitly request Gateway/progress-review instruments in addition to SOW, teaching, CEA/practicals, and assessments.
